actual: REPRODUCE: ask '昨天的本地数据同步任务是否运行正常？' -> RA agentic loop selects tool aistock-local-data/local_data_get_unack_alert_count -> chat/turn 404 with 'approved capability not found for tool: aistock-local-data/local_data_get_unack_alert_count'. ROOT CAUSE: _agentic_function_tools (service.py:3279) offers the FULL manifest read-only catalog (_manifest_mcp_catalog_records, filtered only by side_effect=read_only) to the LLM via function-calling, but execution requires the picked tool to be covered by an approved capability's mcp_tool_refs via _capability_key_for_tool (service.py:4248). local_data.* capabilities cover only a SUBSET (local_data_health_overview, local_data_get_preset_daily_status, ... at service.py:735/737/864/866) and do NOT include local_data_get_unack_alert_count (which IS in tool_manifest.py:119). So the LLM can legitimately pick a manifest tool with no backing capability -> _capability_key_for_tool exhausts approved capabilities -> raises KeyError at service.py:4288. The old single-tool planner picked from a curated domain read_tools set so this gap never surfaced; the agentic loop picks from the full manifest and exposes it. FIX DIRECTION (decide in plan): align the offered function-tool set with the executable/approved set - either (a) restrict _agentic_function_tools to capability-backed tools only, or (b) broaden each domain *.mcp_orchestration capability mcp_tool_refs to cover all of its module read-only tools, or (c) map any read-only manifest tool to a default read-only capability. ACCEPTANCE: add a test that the LLM picking a manifest read-only tool not in the curated capability subset is handled (executed via a covering capability OR gracefully skipped) and never raises capability-not-found to the API. SCOPE NOTE: the hard-fail/404 graceful-degradation aspect is tracked in BUG-404; THIS bug is the catalog<->capability coverage alignment. CONSTRAINTS: fix in worktree not root; no service start; no DDL.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
